note: All8 formation-family -> engine formation template. DERIVED by engine/test/all8-formation-map.mjs from the alignment diagrams in all8-getouts.json, then recorded here so a template rename or geometry change fails loudly.
method: Metric-free shape signature: each dancer's (column rank, row rank, facing) as a SET, compared under all 8 symmetries of the rectangle. The All8 text diagrams carry no distances, so topology and facing are all that can be compared.
caveat: Because the metric is discarded, a 'Compact' template with different spacing is indistinguishable from its standard form and matches too - hence several families list a Compact variant alongside the standard one. Deciding between them needs the lattice spacing, which the diagrams do not give.
observations: Box/8-Chain is the engine's 'Eight Chain Thru' - the shape used in the earlier [B1p] cross-check was the right one, so that failure was NOT a formation-template problem. It lies in the calls and the target.

L-H 2-Face Lines matches the engine's 'Two-Faced Lines' only MIRRORED, while R-H 2-Face Lines matches it identically: the engine's template is the right-handed one, and the left-handed variant is its reflection.

'Two-Faced Lines LH' does not appear separately: getUniqueFormations dedupes congruent shapes INCLUDING reflection, so mirrored pairs collapse to one entry. recognize() still names both, since it uses the undeduped named formations.
Dixie Grand (family 'Special') is unmapped: its page covers six alignments and publishes no single text diagram.

unmapped.reason: no published text diagram (the page covers six alignments inline)
